stories.title: Competition watchdog issues five money-saving tips for drivers at end of summer holidays
stories.summary: Drivers heading home at the end of the summer holidays are being told to compare fuel prices before filling up and to read car park signs carefully. stories.title: Man in custody after driving stolen taxi in wrong direction on A55
stories.summary: A man remains in custody after the vehicle he was driving was stopped while travelling in the wrong direction on the A55 yesterday evening. stories.title: Welsh drug testing service detects new class of synthetic opioid for the first time
stories.summary: A class of synthetic opioid that Wales’s drug testing service had never detected before has been found in samples submitted by people who believed they had bought heroin. stories.title: Flintshire councillors demand pause to Catholic school closure plan after council’s “damning” Estyn report

stories.title: North Wales Police puts domestic abuse specialist in its 999 control room
stories.summary: A domestic abuse specialist has been placed inside the control room where North Wales Police answers 999 and 101 calls. The force announced the appointment on Monday 24 August.
